comment: Material of A-3 (doc/megaliths/A3_DESERT_GATE.md). Generated by tools/blender/megalith_a3_desert_gate.py; the maps are final, the knobs are what made them (the painted materials gate_paint_* stay in the blend).
projection: the mesh's own UVs: one smart-UV atlas for the whole gate

basecolor.what: worn white stone, ivory mottling, faint grey veins, pits a touch darker, a film of sand dust, dust patches on what faces up and at the foot, the passage black; no AO in it; true albedo (no gain needed)

normal.convention: tangent space, OpenGL (+Y up), MikkTSpace from the glTF UVs
normal.what: the worn relief: coarse pitting and fine grit

surface.what: R = baked AO (multiply into ambient), G = roughness (worn 0.78, dust rougher), B = metallic (0)
